03 — Our approach

How the work runs.

A genuine sequence: each step is decided before the next begins, with reviewable progress at every stage.

  1. Brief

    The audience, the action the site must drive, and the constraints.

  2. Design

    Structure and system before pages, with every state considered.

  3. Build

    Production-grade code, measured performance, accessibility by default.

  4. Launch and handover

    Documented, monitored, and yours.

05 — FAQ

The questions asked first.

Which platform will my site be built on?

It depends on the brief. A content-managed marketing site, a static site, and a custom application each call for different tooling. We recommend after discovery, not before.

Can you take over an existing site?

Yes. We audit first, then propose either a redesign on the current platform or a staged rebuild.
